title: Non-Compete Agreements: Purpose, Limits, and Enforceability
summary: PURPLE-L2-009: Non-Compete Agreements: Purpose, Limits, and Enforceability.
body: This PURPLE Level 2 lesson develops practical legal competency in Non-Compete Agreements: Purpose, Limits, and Enforceability. Learners should identify the legal issue, distinguish facts from assumptions, recognise rights, duties, deadlines and available remedies, preserve relevant records, and understand when professional legal advice is appropriate. Laws, procedures, limitation periods and available protections vary by jurisdiction and can change, so current official sources and qualified local counsel should be used where relevant. The objective is informed issue recognition and structured decision-making, not individual legal advice.
